scope: Six-figure paper reference: 22 nominal sources, 14 finite broader-search comparisons, external waveform consistency and recorded source timings; not a global fitting-factor survey or Bayesian eccentricity measurement.
historical_manifest_policy: Historical records are verbatim; their internal paths identify the original campaigns.
historical_material_policy: Obsolete source snapshots, old-to-new score audits, archived population/threshold tables and referee bibliography material remain local and are excluded.
